label: belgium-popsol
_why: Take every Belgian pop's TRUE standard of living and compute demand pop by pop, instead of collapsing each stratum to one wealth level. Buy packages are step functions in wealth, so the collapse cannot buy anything the stratum's mean pop would not buy; spreading each stratum over a fitted band cut pop demand error 33% -> 25%, but a fitted band is a knob. This decides whether the band is a fair shorthand for a real distribution or is hiding a different defect - which is the difference between a loose model and a cover story.
